structural_dependencies: Monteiro Alves–Petrogradsky Theorem 4.1 supplies nilpotence of L, finite-dimensional L' and finite strong invariant in all positive characteristics.
Theorem 4.3 supplies the solvability equivalents only for p>2; characteristic 2 is excluded from that reduction.
Theorem 4.2 separates the strong-class formula from ordinary equality proved for p>3; no extension of that equality is assumed.
